items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You mentioned Samuel Johnson playing sax with Paul. [INTERVIEWEE] He was from home, Louisiana.

ctx.x: He was the business manager. Mm-hmm. And Burgaard Adams was the musical director.
I see. Before I forget it, too, another thing. You mentioned Samuel Johnson playing sax with Paul.
